## Summary
The loose-chasm-knot epic closes each of its own stories using the new typed-enum verifier (S1), deterministic renderer (S2), and handoff gate (S3). A second-source agent independently confirms each mechanism was actually used.

## Done Definitions
- Each story in this epic closed using typed-enum verifier (S1 output)
- Closure narratives rendered via deterministic renderer (S2 output)
- Handoff gate (S3) enforced between each story pair
- Hard machine gate: check-plugin-reload-checkpoint.sh must exit 0 before S11 begins
- Second-source verification: independent agent confirms each mechanism was actually used (not just present in code)
- Audit trail: PREPLANNING_CONTEXT comment updated with self-application evidence

## SC Coverage
SC8, SC11

## Depends On
S1 (typed-enum verifier), S2 (deterministic renderer), S3 (handoff gate)

## Blocked By
S-ExtDep (plugin-reload-checkpoint manual step)

## Escalation Policy
Escalate when blocked
